name: Arclands Corporation
summary: Arclands Corporation engages in the retail business in Japan. The company operates home centers under the HOME CENTER MUSASHI, SUPER CENTER MUSASHI, and VIVA HOME name; pro shop under the MUSASHI PRO and VIVA HOME PRO name; supermarket under the MUSASHI Food Hall name; pet shop under the NICO PET name; and art and craft business under the ARK OASIS and VC'S name.
